name: Ura-Harajuku streetwear
summary: Streetwear from the small shops on the backstreets of Harajuku in Tokyo, from 1993. It has the camouflage-print hoodie, the printed T-shirt and the branded sneaker, sold in small stores and tied to friends in music and design.

philosophy.core_thesis: A small shop on a backstreet is the centre of the style: a few friends make graphic clothes for their own scene, and the mark on the chest says who belongs.
design_principles: Print a mascot, a pattern or a name on the T-shirt and the hoodie in flat colours.
Cover a hoodie or a jacket in a camouflage print in two to four colours.
Cut the T-shirt and the hoodie slightly boxy, 4 to 8 cm wider than the body.
Choose a sneaker with a clean low court shape and a small logo on the side.
Add a small trim detail: a woven label, a snap or a full zip.
Sell the piece in a small shop and let friends and artists add their own marks to it.
Pair the garment with a cap and a plain, washed jean.
anti_patterns: Sharp tailoring and a pressed crease
A mass-market logo on a plain, cheap T-shirt
A skate-brand look with a hard, heavy fit

silhouette.shape: A slightly boxy top over a straight or slim jean, finished by a cap and a clean low sneaker.
silhouette.line: A soft shoulder, a hoodie hem at the hip, and a jean hem that rests on the sneaker.
silhouette.fit: Relaxed on top and close on the leg; the garment is easy to move in but not as wide as the parent style.
silhouette.proportion: T-shirt 4 to 8 cm wider than the chest. Hoodie hem at the hip. Jean leg 18 to 22 cm at the hem. Cap crown 9 cm.
rules: Drop the shoulder seam 2 to 5 cm below the natural line.
Keep the hoodie hem and cuff in a rib knit.
Cut the jean straight or slim, and let the hem rest on the shoe.
Place the main print on the chest or the back, at 15 to 30 cm in width.
Add a cap and a low sneaker.

fabrics.rule: Choose washable cotton from sport and work: jersey, terry and denim. Print the camouflage or the graphic on the cotton, not on a delicate cloth.

methods: boxy cut with a soft shoulder
construction.closures: A full zip with a hood, a snap, or a plain pullover; trousers with a button fly or a drawcord.
construction.details: A woven neck label, a small embroidered patch, a camouflage lining and a sneaker with a side logo.

surface.pattern: A camouflage print in two to four colours, a mascot or a name on the chest, and a plain block of colour.
surface.gloss: Cotton at 2–8 GU; a print at 10–40 GU; leather at 20–50 GU.
surface.wear: A new piece is prized; a washed and softened piece is also liked.

palette.strategy: A base of black, white and grey, with a green camouflage family and one or two strong accent colours.

processes: cut and sew in small runs
collaboration with artists and other labels
making.scale: A small shop and a small team at the start; later a chain of stores and many collaborations.
making.signs: A woven neck label, a printed hang tag, and a heavy knit with a clean rib.

pieces.form: Full-zip hooded sweatshirt in an all-over camouflage print
Boxy cotton T-shirt with a chest graphic
Straight jeans with a washed face
Straight twill trousers with a drawcord and a camouflage lining

positive: low white leather sneaker with a side logo

emotion.target_response: A feeling of belonging to a small, in-the-know scene: the viewer sees a playful, graphic look that friends share.

use_cases: a Tokyo streetwear line or shop brief
a street fashion image prompt set in Harajuku
a costume brief for a youth film in Japan
a study note on the Japanese streetwear scene
avoid_when: the brief wants formal or tailored dress
the brief wants the wide, baggy west-coast look
the brief wants a quiet, no-logo luxury look

modifiers.how: Remove the camouflage and the print, use a fine knit, and keep the straight leg.
Widen the T-shirt and the jean, and swap the camouflage for a plain chest logo.
